date_inferred_from: Entered on leaf 507 verso of the book for 1778 and 1779, well after the sitting of 1 May 1779 (leaf 358 verso). The heading of the sitting at the top of the page is cut off by the edge of the photograph.
text:

Antoni Prusimski Star: Nieszczewski

translation.en:
Let there be seen in this place a certain copy of a manifest made on behalf of the Most Honourable Prusimski against the Honourables Nosalski, as is apparent from the copy in the produced documents.

Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice

text_english:
Let there be seen in this place a certain copy of a manifest made on behalf of the Most Honourable Prusimski against the Honourables Nosalski, as is apparent from the copy in the produced documents.

Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice
summary_en: A register note of 1779: a copy of the protest that Prusimski made against the Nosalskis is among the documents produced. Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, signed.
summary_de: Registervermerk von 1779: Eine Abschrift des Protests, den Prusimski gegen die Nosalski eingelegt hat, liegt bei den vorgelegten Schriftstücken. Antoni Prusimski, Starost von Niszczewice, hat unterschrieben.
